extras.real_size: 1950s four-door sedan, approx. 5.5 x 2.0 x 1.56 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.72 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic, brand-free 1950s family sedan: two-tone paint (mint body, cream cabin and side flash), wraparound windshield and rear window, tail fins with round tail lights, wide chrome grille, chrome bumpers with guards, whitewall tyres; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, two bench seats and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
